items_flat.title_en: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company for Codex and Git tooling
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI將收購Pierre Computer Company以強化Codex與Git工具
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced it will acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc., maker of Code Storage and open-source tools including Trees and Diffs already used in Codex. The deal aims to evolve Git workflows for parallel agentic coding, with open-source projects remaining open and Code Storage continuing for customers while features integrate into Codex.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布將收購Pierre Computer Company, Inc.，該公司開發Code Storage以及已用於Codex的Trees與Diffs等開源工具。交易旨在為平行代理編碼演進Git工作流程，開源專案將維持開源，Code Storage功能將逐步整合進Codex。
items_flat.analysis_en: This expands OpenAI’s control over the developer stack around Codex as agentic coding scales, potentially setting standards for source control that blend human decisions with agent parallelism. Closing depends on regulatory approvals and integration speed remains uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉擴大OpenAI對Codex周邊開發者堆疊的控制，隨著代理編碼擴張，可能為混合人類決策與代理並行的源碼控制設定標準。交易完成取決於監管批准，整合速度仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: Today we're announcing that OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc. (“Pierre”), the company behind Code Storage and a family of standout open-source developer tools.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們宣布OpenAI將收購Pierre Computer Company, Inc.（「Pierre」），該公司開發Code Storage以及一系列傑出的開源開發者工具。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI autonomous pipeline finds and patches 948 Linux kernel LPE vulnerabilities
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI自主管道發現並修補948個Linux核心本地提權漏洞
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI detailed an autonomous vulnerability discovery, validation, and patching pipeline using an upcoming cyber model that identified 2,308 candidates in the Linux kernel, dynamically reproduced 1,724, and generated 948 working local privilege escalation exploits at a cost of about $1.2 million in API credits, plus novel exploitation techniques.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI詳述使用即將推出的網路模型之自主漏洞發現、驗證與修補管道，在Linux核心中識別2,308個候選，動態重現1,724個，並產生948個有效本地提權漏洞利用，API成本約120萬美元，並發現新穎利用技術。
items_flat.analysis_en: The result shows frontier cyber models can systematically surface and exploit latent kernel bugs at scale far beyond manual efforts, raising both defensive capability and the urgency of automated patching. Real-world impact depends on maintainer uptake and whether similar pipelines proliferate to attackers.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 結果顯示前沿網路模型能系統性大規模發現並利用潛伏核心錯誤，遠超人工努力，同時提升防禦能力與自動化修補急迫性。實際影響取決於維護者採用程度，以及類似管道是否擴散至攻擊者。
items_flat.quote: We've developed an autonomous vulnerability discovery, exploitation, and patching pipeline. In one run with our cyber model, it validated and generated patches for 948 local privilege escalation vulnerabilities in Linux at an API cost of $1.2 million.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們開發了自主漏洞發現、利用與修補管道。在使用網路模型的一次運行中，它驗證並為Linux中的948個本地提權漏洞產生修補，API成本為120萬美元。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Images 2.6 with GIF creation and 50% faster generation
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出Images 2.6，支援GIF生成且速度快50%
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced Images 2.6 in ChatGPT, Codex, and the API, adding GIF generation from prompts or images, saved reference images for consistency, and new API models GPT-Image-2.6 Flare and Sunburst that generate images 50% faster. Flare can produce images in as little as six seconds at low quality.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI在ChatGPT、Codex與API中推出Images 2.6，新增從提示詞或圖像生成GIF、保存參考圖像以保持一致性，以及新API模型GPT-Image-2.6 Flare與Sunburst，圖像生成速度快50%。Flare在低品質設定下可在六秒內生成圖像。
items_flat.analysis_en: Faster iteration plus native GIFs and reference consistency lowers the barrier for professional and social creative workflows inside ChatGPT and developer tools. Adoption will depend on quality parity with specialized tools and how safety filters handle animated content.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更快迭代加上原生GIF與參考一致性，降低ChatGPT與開發工具內專業與社群創意工作流程的門檻。採用程度將取決於與專業工具的品質對等，以及安全過濾如何處理動畫內容。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing Images 2.6 in ChatGPT, Codex, and the API, bringing your ideas to life faster. With this, you can bring motion to your images with GIFs.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們在ChatGPT、Codex與API中推出Images 2.6，讓你的想法更快實現。透過此功能，你可以用GIF為圖像增添動態。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic open-sources FlashProve for provable inference of model outputs
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic開源FlashProve以可證明推理驗證模型輸出
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team released FlashProve, an open-source (Apache 2.0) prototype using zkSNARKs so developers can verify a response came from a specific model without revealing weights. On Llama 4 Maverick (400B MoE, 4-bit), a single H100 generates proofs at ~110 tokens/second with ~19 MB proofs per 1,024 tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic Frontier Red Team釋出FlashProve，這是使用zkSNARKs的開源（Apache 2.0）原型，讓開發者能驗證回應來自特定模型而不揭露權重。在Llama 4 Maverick（400B MoE，4-bit）上，單一H100以約110 tokens/秒產生證明，每1,024 tokens證明約19 MB。
items_flat.analysis_en: This advances practical cryptographic verification of model identity, addressing trust issues in routing, evaluation, and potential substitution. It remains a research prototype with high relative compute cost and no current deployment plans at Anthropic or elsewhere.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此進展推進模型身份的實用密碼學驗證，解決路由、評估與潛在替換的信任問題。它仍是研究原型，相對計算成本高，目前Anthropic或其他地方無部署計畫。
items_flat.quote: Today we are releasing FlashProve: an open-source performant prototype for provable inference.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們釋出FlashProve：一個用於可證明推理的開源高效原型。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for 1-trillion-parameter Large 4
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral釋出1兆參數Large 4的開源權重
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of Mistral Large 4 (nicknamed Le Chonk), a natively multimodal MoE model with ~1 trillion total / ~49-52 billion active parameters, on Hugging Face under a modified MIT license. Trained on 3,800 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPUs in Europe, it shows strong agentic coding and cyber results after additional RL.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral在Hugging Face上以修改版MIT授權釋出Mistral Large 4（暱稱Le Chonk）的開源權重，這是原生多模態MoE模型，總參數約1兆、活躍參數約490-520億。在歐洲3,800個Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPU上訓練，額外RL後在代理編碼與網路防禦表現強勁。
items_flat.analysis_en: This strengthens the open-weight frontier outside the US closed labs, offering a high-capacity European alternative for coding and multimodal work. Adoption will hinge on inference cost, license terms for hosted services, and how it compares on independent benchmarks.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉強化美國封閉實驗室以外的開源權重前沿，為編碼與多模態工作提供高容量歐洲替代方案。採用將取決於推理成本、託管服務授權條款，以及獨立基準上的表現。

items_flat.title_en: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor for parallel agent orchestration
items_flat.title_zh: Meta收購AI編碼新創Conductor以進行平行代理編排
items_flat.summary_en: Meta acquired Conductor, a startup whose platform lets developers run multiple AI coding agents (from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in parallel isolated workspaces. Founder Charlie Holtz confirmed the deal on X and said the team will work on Muse Code and Superintelligence Labs efforts.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta收購Conductor，該新創平台讓開發者在平行隔離工作空間中運行多個AI編碼代理（來自Claude Code、Codex、Cursor等）。創辦人Charlie Holtz在X上確認交易，並表示團隊將致力於Muse Code與Superintelligence Labs。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal places Meta in the same race as OpenAI to own developer orchestration tools as coding agents proliferate, potentially accelerating its Muse Code and Superintelligence Labs roadmap. Details on product integration and timeline remain limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此交易讓Meta與OpenAI同樣競逐開發者編排工具，隨著編碼代理 proliferate，可能加速其Muse Code與Superintelligence Labs路線圖。產品整合與時程細節仍有限。
items_flat.quote: I am very excited to share that Conductor is joining Meta! We have some big, crazy plans for the next interface.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我非常興奮地分享 Conductor 即將加入 Meta！我們對下一代介面有一些很大、很瘋狂的計畫。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic uses Claude to map first 3D structure of a prokaryotic vault particle
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic使用Claude繪製首個原核生物vault粒子的3D結構
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s biology research team reported the first cryo-EM structure of a vault-like particle assembled from a bacteriophage protein (L05), showing prokaryotic and phage MVP homologs can form vaults. Claude assisted literature search, isolation optimization (from days to ~90 minutes), and structure mapping under human direction.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic生物研究團隊報告首個由噬菌體蛋白（L05）組裝的vault樣粒子冷凍電鏡結構，顯示原核生物與噬菌體MVP同源蛋白可形成vault。Claude在人類指導下協助文獻搜尋、分離優化（從數天縮至約90分鐘）與結構繪製。
items_flat.analysis_en: This demonstrates AI accelerating a long-standing open problem in cell biology by compressing multi-week structural work into days under human direction, while still requiring expert oversight. Function of vaults remains unknown, so scientific impact is still early.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉展示AI在人類指導下將數週結構工作壓縮至數天，加速細胞生物學長期開放問題，但仍需專家監督。vault功能仍未知，科學影響仍屬早期。
items_flat.quote: We’re sharing another finding from Anthropic’s biology research lab: the first 3D structure of a vault particle found in prokaryotic cells.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們分享Anthropic生物研究實驗室的另一項發現：在原核細胞中發現的首個vault粒子3D結構。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Daybreak Red (GPT-5.6 Cyber) available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI Daybreak Red（GPT-5.6 Cyber）在AWS GovCloud（US-East）上線
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced that GPT-5.6 Cyber via Daybreak Red is now available to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Amazon Bedrock. It supports authorized vulnerability research, exploit validation, and security testing with fewer restrictions than general models.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布透過Daybreak Red的GPT-5.6 Cyber現已透過Amazon Bedrock在AWS GovCloud（US-East）向核准客戶提供。它支援授權的漏洞研究、漏洞利用驗證與安全測試，限制少於一般模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: This extends specialized cyber capabilities into government-grade cloud environments, lowering barriers for public-sector defenders. Broader availability and real-world impact will depend on approval processes and how safeguards balance capability with misuse risk.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉將專門網路能力延伸至政府級雲端環境，降低公共部門防禦者門檻。更廣泛可用性與實際影響將取決於核准流程，以及安全措施如何平衡能力與濫用風險。
items_flat.quote: Building on the availability of Daybreak models on Amazon Bedrock, GPT‑5.6 Cyber is now available to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Daybreak Red.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在Daybreak模型於Amazon Bedrock提供的基礎上，GPT‑5.6 Cyber現已透過Daybreak Red向核准客戶在AWS GovCloud（US-East）提供。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI appoints Jill Hazelbaker as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI任命Jill Hazelbaker為首席企業事務官
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI appointed Jill Hazelbaker, formerly President and Chief Corporate Affairs Officer at Uber (with prior roles at Snap and Google), as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer to lead global communications and corporate positioning. She will report to the CEO.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI任命Jill Hazelbaker（前Uber總裁兼首席企業事務官，曾於Snap與Google任職）為首席企業事務官，領導全球溝通與企業定位。她將向CEO匯報。
items_flat.analysis_en: The hire signals OpenAI’s increased investment in external relations and reputation management as it scales. Effectiveness will depend on how the role navigates ongoing regulatory, safety, and competitive pressures.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此任命顯示OpenAI在擴張時增加外部關係與聲譽管理投資。成效將取決於該角色如何應對持續的監管、安全與競爭壓力。
items_flat.quote: Jill Hazelbaker will join OpenAI as Chief Corporate Affairs Officer, leading the company’s global communications and corporate positioning.
items_flat.quote_zh: Jill Hazelbaker將加入OpenAI擔任首席企業事務長，領導公司的全球通訊與企業定位。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind adds agentic cheminformatics skills to Antigravity for drug discovery
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind為Antigravity加入代理化學資訊學技能以加速藥物發現
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Cheminformatics Skills for Google Antigravity that combine language-model orchestration with deterministic tools (RDKit, ChEMBL, PubChem). In a lung-cancer example, an agent searched thousands of compounds, performed matched-pair analysis, and proposed novel rigidified macrocycles with synthetic routes, compressing multi-day loops.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind為Google Antigravity釋出化學資訊學技能，結合語言模型編排與確定性工具（RDKit、ChEMBL、PubChem）。在肺癌範例中，代理搜尋數千化合物、進行配對分析，並提出帶合成路徑的新穎剛性化大環，將多日迴圈壓縮。
items_flat.analysis_en: The release shows agentic systems compressing multi-day medicinal chemistry loops into hours by delegating calculation to specialized tools while the model handles planning and reasoning. Broader impact depends on experimental validation rates and integration into real discovery pipelines.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此釋出顯示代理系統透過將計算委託給專門工具、模型處理規劃與推理，將多日藥物化學迴圈壓縮至數小時。更廣泛影響取決於實驗驗證率與整合至真實發現管道的程度。
items_flat.quote: Here we show how Google Antigravity, equipped with our new Cheminformatics Skills, accelerates drug discovery workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這裡我們展示配備新化學資訊技能的 Google Antigravity 如何加速藥物發現工作流程。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic open-sources FlashProve for provable inference of model outputs
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic開源FlashProve以可證明推理驗證模型輸出
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team released FlashProve, an open-source (Apache 2.0) prototype using zkSNARKs so developers can verify a response came from a specific model without revealing weights. On Llama 4 Maverick (400B MoE, 4-bit), a single H100 generates proofs at ~110 tokens/second with ~19 MB proofs per 1,024 tokens.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic Frontier Red Team釋出FlashProve，這是使用zkSNARKs的開源（Apache 2.0）原型，讓開發者能驗證回應來自特定模型而不揭露權重。在Llama 4 Maverick（400B MoE，4-bit）上，單一H100以約110 tokens/秒產生證明，每1,024 tokens證明約19 MB。
anthropic.analysis_en: This advances practical cryptographic verification of model identity, addressing trust issues in routing, evaluation, and potential substitution. It remains a research prototype with high relative compute cost and no current deployment plans at Anthropic or elsewhere.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 此進展推進模型身份的實用密碼學驗證，解決路由、評估與潛在替換的信任問題。它仍是研究原型，相對計算成本高，目前Anthropic或其他地方無部署計畫。
anthropic.quote: Today we are releasing FlashProve: an open-source performant prototype for provable inference.
anthropic.quote_zh: 今天我們釋出FlashProve：一個用於可證明推理的開源高效原型。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic uses Claude to map first 3D structure of a prokaryotic vault particle
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic使用Claude繪製首個原核生物vault粒子的3D結構
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic’s biology research team reported the first cryo-EM structure of a vault-like particle assembled from a bacteriophage protein (L05), showing prokaryotic and phage MVP homologs can form vaults. Claude assisted literature search, isolation optimization (from days to ~90 minutes), and structure mapping under human direction.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic生物研究團隊報告首個由噬菌體蛋白（L05）組裝的vault樣粒子冷凍電鏡結構，顯示原核生物與噬菌體MVP同源蛋白可形成vault。Claude在人類指導下協助文獻搜尋、分離優化（從數天縮至約90分鐘）與結構繪製。
anthropic.analysis_en: This demonstrates AI accelerating a long-standing open problem in cell biology by compressing multi-week structural work into days under human direction, while still requiring expert oversight. Function of vaults remains unknown, so scientific impact is still early.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 此舉展示AI在人類指導下將數週結構工作壓縮至數天，加速細胞生物學長期開放問題，但仍需專家監督。vault功能仍未知，科學影響仍屬早期。
anthropic.quote: We’re sharing another finding from Anthropic’s biology research lab: the first 3D structure of a vault particle found in prokaryotic cells.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們分享Anthropic生物研究實驗室的另一項發現：在原核細胞中發現的首個vault粒子3D結構。

google.title_en: Google DeepMind adds agentic cheminformatics skills to Antigravity for drug discovery
google.title_zh: Google DeepMind為Antigravity加入代理化學資訊學技能以加速藥物發現
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Cheminformatics Skills for Google Antigravity that combine language-model orchestration with deterministic tools (RDKit, ChEMBL, PubChem). In a lung-cancer example, an agent searched thousands of compounds, performed matched-pair analysis, and proposed novel rigidified macrocycles with synthetic routes, compressing multi-day loops.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind為Google Antigravity釋出化學資訊學技能，結合語言模型編排與確定性工具（RDKit、ChEMBL、PubChem）。在肺癌範例中，代理搜尋數千化合物、進行配對分析，並提出帶合成路徑的新穎剛性化大環，將多日迴圈壓縮。
google.analysis_en: The release shows agentic systems compressing multi-day medicinal chemistry loops into hours by delegating calculation to specialized tools while the model handles planning and reasoning. Broader impact depends on experimental validation rates and integration into real discovery pipelines.
google.analysis_zh: 此釋出顯示代理系統透過將計算委託給專門工具、模型處理規劃與推理，將多日藥物化學迴圈壓縮至數小時。更廣泛影響取決於實驗驗證率與整合至真實發現管道的程度。
google.quote: Here we show how Google Antigravity, equipped with our new Cheminformatics Skills, accelerates drug discovery workflows.
google.quote_zh: 這裡我們展示配備新化學資訊技能的 Google Antigravity 如何加速藥物發現工作流程。

meta.title_en: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor for parallel agent orchestration
meta.title_zh: Meta收購AI編碼新創Conductor以進行平行代理編排
meta.summary_en: Meta acquired Conductor, a startup whose platform lets developers run multiple AI coding agents (from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in parallel isolated workspaces. Founder Charlie Holtz confirmed the deal on X and said the team will work on Muse Code and Superintelligence Labs efforts.
meta.summary_zh: Meta收購Conductor，該新創平台讓開發者在平行隔離工作空間中運行多個AI編碼代理（來自Claude Code、Codex、Cursor等）。創辦人Charlie Holtz在X上確認交易，並表示團隊將致力於Muse Code與Superintelligence Labs。
meta.analysis_en: The deal places Meta in the same race as OpenAI to own developer orchestration tools as coding agents proliferate, potentially accelerating its Muse Code and Superintelligence Labs roadmap. Details on product integration and timeline remain limited.
meta.analysis_zh: 此交易讓Meta與OpenAI同樣競逐開發者編排工具，隨著編碼代理 proliferate，可能加速其Muse Code與Superintelligence Labs路線圖。產品整合與時程細節仍有限。
meta.quote: I am very excited to share that Conductor is joining Meta! We have some big, crazy plans for the next interface.
meta.quote_zh: 我非常興奮地分享 Conductor 即將加入 Meta！我們對下一代介面有一些很大、很瘋狂的計畫。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for 1-trillion-parameter Large 4
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral釋出1兆參數Large 4的開源權重
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of Mistral Large 4 (nicknamed Le Chonk), a natively multimodal MoE model with ~1 trillion total / ~49-52 billion active parameters, on Hugging Face under a modified MIT license. Trained on 3,800 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPUs in Europe, it shows strong agentic coding and cyber results after additional RL.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral在Hugging Face上以修改版MIT授權釋出Mistral Large 4（暱稱Le Chonk）的開源權重，這是原生多模態MoE模型，總參數約1兆、活躍參數約490-520億。在歐洲3,800個Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPU上訓練，額外RL後在代理編碼與網路防禦表現強勁。
frontier_other.analysis_en: This strengthens the open-weight frontier outside the US closed labs, offering a high-capacity European alternative for coding and multimodal work. Adoption will hinge on inference cost, license terms for hosted services, and how it compares on independent benchmarks.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 此舉強化美國封閉實驗室以外的開源權重前沿，為編碼與多模態工作提供高容量歐洲替代方案。採用將取決於推理成本、託管服務授權條款，以及獨立基準上的表現。

brief_en: OpenAI detailed an autonomous cyber pipeline that found and patched 948 Linux kernel LPE vulnerabilities, launched Images 2.6 with GIFs and faster models, and announced the Pierre acquisition for Codex tooling. Anthropic open-sourced FlashProve for provable inference and used Claude to map the first prokaryotic vault structure. Mistral released open weights for its 1T Large 4; Meta acquired Conductor; Google added agentic cheminformatics to Antigravity.
brief_zh: OpenAI揭露自主網路管道發現並修補948個Linux核心本地提權漏洞，推出Images 2.6支援GIF與更快模型，並宣布收購Pierre強化Codex工具。Anthropic開源FlashProve可驗證推理，並用Claude繪製首個原核生物vault結構。Mistral釋出1T Large 4開源權重；Meta收購Conductor；Google為Antigravity加入代理化學資訊學。
